turns.reply:
I solved level 6 in 73 actions. The human baseline is 49 and my cap was 245, so I finished well under the cap but about 1.5 times the baseline. Much of the cost came from early trial clicks and one reset.

**Rules I found:**
- Clicking a blob, an outline or a bead moves the head (the 0-blob with a 4 in it).
- Clicking an anchor (a 3-433 node) swaps that anchor with the head.
- A bead sits at the midpoint or centroid of its anchors plus the head.
- A bead picks up any coloured blob that lands on it.
- To win, each bead must hold the colours of an outline and sit inside that outline.
- To leave a bead in place, click the bead so the head moves onto it. Then click another anchor to swap the head away.

**What completed the level:**
1. I built a b/a/6 bead and left it in the b/6/a outline.
2. I built an f/e/9 bead and moved it into the f/e/9 outline.

The 7/6 outline seemed to need nothing.

I saved these rules as a global memory named "task-2b8eb1d5 rules", so later instances of this game can use them.
